rows.what_the_ink_shows: In 1′ the disputed capital has upper and middle bars plus a separate lower horizontal stroke, followed by a small subscript 0 (crops/161-1_scan006_L1164.jpg). This supports the retained E_0. The adjacent E_0 in 1 has the corresponding three-bar form; 3′ instead has an F with a long descending stem and no lower bar (comparison crops).
rows.note: Keep the written E_0 in 1′. The lower horizontal is detached from the upright, but its position and the short upright distinguish this form from the local F in 3′. The supplied F_0 is a mathematical correction of this written value. No proof of the equivalences or adjunction claims was checked; the separate 3′ F_0 remains as already transcribed.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Compared the original 1′ E_0 with the disputed ink and the local E_0 and 3′ F_0 forms. The lower bar supports preserving E_0; no mathematical claim was independently verified.
